source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of crossing over (PDF 102-103).

blocks.text: Gametes bante waqt, meiosis I mein, homologous chromosomes crossing over se guzarte hain, jo linked genes ke naye milap (recombination) ka zimmedar hai. Do homologous chromosomes ke chromatids aik doosre ke saath qatar mein aate aur DNA ke hisse badalte hain; DNA strands waqai toot kar dobara jurte hain. Is ke baad homologous chromosomes alag ho jate hain.

blocks.alt: Baen se daen chaar marhale. 1: homologous jora, do neele chromatids par alleles A aur B, do surkh par a aur b. 2: andar wale neele aur surkh chromatids aik chiasma par aik doosre ko kaat te hain. 3: andar wale chromatids ne neeche ke hisse badal liye, ab A ke saath b aur a ke saath B. 4: chaar gametes, AB aur ab parental aur Ab aur aB recombinant.
blocks.caption: Non-sister chromatids ke darmiyan crossing over (Figure 18.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Meiosis I ke prophase mein homologous chromosomes jora banate hain, har aik do sister chromatids ka. Non-sister chromatids aik chiasma par chhoote hain, un ke DNA strands toot kar dobara jurte hain, aur woh barabar ke hisse badal lete hain. Is ke baad har chromatid par wahi genes usi tarteeb mein hote hain, lekin chaar mein se do par alleles ke naye milap (Ab aur aB) hote hain. Jab homologues aur phir chromatids gametes mein jate hain to yeh recombinant chromatids tanawwu (variety) barhate hain; isi liye crossing over genetic variation ka zariya hai aur linkage aksar incomplete hoti hai.

blocks.text: Shamil chromatids par ab bhi wahi genes usi tarteeb mein hote hain, lekin un ke alleles nayi tarteeb mein aa jate hain. Jab yeh recombinant chromatids mukhtalif gametes mein jate hain to gametes ki bari variety banti hai, is liye crossing over genes ke naye milap laata aur genetic tanawwu ka zariya hai.

blocks.title: Do taash ki gaddiyan sochiye
blocks.text: Do taash ki gaddiyan saath saath sochiye, aik neeli pusht wali aur aik surkh, dono aik hi tarteeb mein. Dono ko aik hi jagah se kaat kar neeche ke aadhe badal dein: har card ki jagah wahi hai, lekin ab har gaddi mein neele aur surkh dono card hain.

blocks.prompt: AB aur ab chromatids wale cell mein A aur B ke darmiyan aik crossover hota hai. Kaun se gametes bante hain?
blocks.explanation: Do parental (AB aur ab) aur do recombinant (Ab aur aB).

items: Crossing over: meiosis I mein non-sister chromatids ka tabadla.
Wahi genes, wahi tarteeb, alleles ke naye milap: genetic variation.
